name: Cocoa
good_with_kids: Yes, kids 8 and older (can jump up when excited)
alone_time: Up to 4-5 hours once settled; still learning to be calm in a crate
special_needs: None. Needs at least an hour of exercise every day.
story: Cocoa came to us as a stray and has blossomed in foster care. He loves fetch, water and learning new cues, and he is working on loose-leash walking.

name: Waffles
good_with_kids: Yes, gentle with children of all ages
good_with_cats: Yes, lived with a cat in foster
special_needs: On a vet-supervised weight-management feeding plan; barks at the doorbell.
story: Waffles is a social butterfly who greets every visitor like a long-lost friend. She was surrendered when her owner moved into a no-pets apartment.

name: Maple
good_with_kids: Best with children 10 and older; can be nervous with sudden noise and movement
alone_time: Still working on this - tends to bark when left alone for long periods
special_needs: Needs a quiet home and gradual alone-time practice. Heavy coat needs brushing 3 times a week.
story: Maple is a gentle soul who bonds deeply with one or two people. She is happiest on short walks, puzzle feeders and a spot near her person.

name: Misty
alone_time: Fine on her own during a workday
special_needs: Indoor only. Long coat needs brushing 3 times a week.
story: Misty is a calm lap cat who takes a day or two to warm up and then follows her person from room to room.

name: Juniper
breed_note: Domestic medium-hair, tabby and white (staff estimate)
good_with_dogs: Yes, lived with a friendly dog in foster
alone_time: Needs toys and window perches; can get into mischief when bored
special_needs: Indoor only. Needs daily play sessions.
story: Juniper is a curious, playful young cat who chases feather wands, loves boxes and greets visitors at the door.

name: Biscuit
good_with_kids: Yes, kids 10 and older; shy at first
special_needs: Three-legged (front leg amputated, fully healed a year ago); no stairs-heavy homes, a ramp helps. Sniffs everything on walks.
story: Biscuit is a shy three-legged beagle who needs a few days to trust but is a velcro dog once he does. He was found as a stray and has been with us for four months.
